_help: One entry per blog post, newest anywhere (the site sorts by date). slug = folder name in /posts. langs = which files exist: posts/<slug>/tr.md, posts/<slug>/en.md. country = 2-letter code from countries.json, city = a city id from that country (both optional). cover = image URL or a file in the post folder. draft: true hides the post (open blog.html?drafts=1 to preview drafts).
